record.name: Supabase
record.one_liner: Supabase provides a full Postgres database for every project with Realtime functionality, database backups, extensions, Auth, Storage, and Edge Functions, along with client libraries, a CLI, and a Management API.

auth.notes: Supabase Auth uses JSON Web Tokens (JWTs) for authentication.

access.notes: Users can start for free on a self-serve tier by signing up on the pricing/dashboard pages.

api_surface.notes: Supports REST and GraphQL APIs, as well as a Management API and CLI.

mcp.notes: The Supabase MCP server connects AI assistants to Supabase so they can inspect your schema and act on your projects on your behalf.

buildability.reasoning: Credentials are self-serve (jwt) and the pages document a usable API surface. (Derived from access, auth and api_surface.)
